name: Ryoujoku Rensa
source:
School's student council president is a universally respectable leader, but behind the cover he heads underground prostitution organization "bonds" to collect money for father who is school's president.
Different girls with different stories all become victims here.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
学校学生会长是受人普遍敬重的领袖，但表面之下，他领导地下卖淫组织「bonds」，为担任学校理事长的父亲筹钱。
拥有不同故事的女孩们，都在这里成为受害者。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
